tasks.title: Set up project folder structure
tasks.description: Create all required directories (CSV_INPUT/, EXCEL/, EXCEL/backups/, LOGS/, ARCHIVE/processed_files/). Create requirements.txt with openpyxl, pandas, and python-dateutil dependencies. Validate directory structure exists.
tasks.details: Foundation task: Set up the complete folder structure as specified in the PRD. Create requirements.txt with all necessary Python dependencies. This is the first step before any code can be written.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all directories exist, requirements.txt contains correct packages, and structure matches PRD specification.

tasks.title: Implement basic file detection
tasks.description: Create function to find newest file in CSV_INPUT/ directory by modification time. Support both .csv and .xlsx file extensions. Handle empty directory gracefully. Return file path or None.
tasks.details: Implement file detection logic that finds the most recently modified file in CSV_INPUT/. Must handle both .csv and .xlsx formats. Should return None if directory is empty and log appropriate message.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with empty directory, single file, multiple files with different modification times, and files with different extensions.

tasks.title: Implement basic logging system
tasks.description: Create logging module that writes to LOGS/import_log.txt. Include timestamp formatting, log levels (INFO, WARNING, ERROR), and append mode. Create log directory if it doesn't exist.
tasks.details: Set up comprehensive logging system that writes timestamped entries to LOGS/import_log.txt. Support different log levels and ensure directory is created if missing.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify log file creation, timestamp formatting, log level filtering, and append functionality.

tasks.title: Implement CSV file parsing
tasks.description: Read CSV files from CSV_INPUT/. Handle different encodings (utf-8, latin-1). Parse headers and extract required fields: SerialNo, Pm, Isc, Voc(V), Ipm, Vpm(V), Date, TTime. Return list of dictionaries.
tasks.details: Parse CSV files with flexible encoding handling. Extract all required fields and optional fields. Handle missing headers gracefully. Return structured data as list of dictionaries.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various CSV formats, different encodings, missing columns, and malformed data.

tasks.title: Implement XLSX file parsing
tasks.description: Read Excel files from CSV_INPUT/ using openpyxl or pandas. Extract required fields from first sheet. Handle different header row positions. Return list of dictionaries matching CSV format.
tasks.details: Parse Excel files using openpyxl or pandas. Extract data from first sheet, handle header row detection, and return data in same format as CSV parser for consistency.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various Excel formats, different header positions, multiple sheets, and edge cases.

tasks.title: Implement data normalization
tasks.description: Strip whitespace from all string fields. Remove Excel-style ="SERIAL" wrappers. Convert numeric fields (Pm, Isc, Voc, Ipm, Vpm) to floats. Handle empty strings, None values, and invalid numbers gracefully. Return normalized data.
tasks.details: Normalize all input data to ensure consistency. Remove Excel formula wrappers, clean whitespace, and convert numeric values. Handle edge cases without crashing.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with wrapped values, extra whitespace, empty fields, None values, and invalid numeric strings.

tasks.title: Implement data validation
tasks.description: Validate required fields (SerialNo, Pm, Isc, Voc, Ipm, Vpm) are present and valid. Check SerialNo is non-empty string. Check numeric fields are valid floats. Skip rows with missing or invalid data. Return valid records and list of skipped records with reasons.
tasks.details: Validate all required fields are present and properly formatted. Skip invalid rows and log reasons. Never crash on bad data.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with missing fields, invalid types, empty SerialNos, and non-numeric electrical values.

tasks.title: Implement latest-run-wins deduplication
tasks.description: Group records by SerialNo. For duplicates, prefer latest Date + TTime combination. If Date/TTime missing, use last row in group. If processing multiple files, use file modification time as primary tiebreaker. Return single record per SerialNo.
tasks.details: Implement deduplication logic that ensures only the most recent data per SerialNo is kept. Use Date/TTime as primary sort, file modification time as tiebreaker.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with duplicate SerialNos, missing dates, same timestamps, and multiple files with same SerialNos.

tasks.title: Implement workbook selection logic
tasks.description: Check if EXCEL/CURRENT.xlsx exists and use it. Otherwise, find most recently modified .xlsx in EXCEL/ containing "BUILD", a year (e.g., 2026), and quarter token (Q1, Q-1, Q 1, etc.). Ignore files starting with "~$". Support --xlsx command-line override. Return workbook path or raise error.
tasks.details: Implement smart workbook selection that prioritizes CURRENT.xlsx, then finds quarterly workbooks by pattern matching. Support command-line override for flexibility.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with CURRENT.xlsx present, missing CURRENT.xlsx, multiple quarterly files, pattern matching, and command-line override.

tasks.title: Implement Excel backup creation
tasks.description: Before modifying workbook, create timestamped backup in EXCEL/backups/ directory. Format: BUILD_YYYY_Q-X_backup_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.xlsx. Use openpyxl to copy workbook. Create backups directory if needed. Log backup location.
tasks.details: Create safety backup before any modifications. Use descriptive filename with timestamp. Ensure backup directory exists.
tasks.testStrategy: Test backup creation, filename formatting, directory creation, and verify backup is identical to original.

tasks.title: Implement SerialNo lookup in DATA sheet
tasks.description: Open workbook using openpyxl. Find DATA sheet. Search column B for existing SerialNo values. Return dictionary mapping SerialNo to row number. Handle missing DATA sheet gracefully.
tasks.details: Open Excel workbook and locate existing SerialNos in DATA sheet column B. Create mapping for efficient updates. Handle missing sheet error.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with existing SerialNos, empty DATA sheet, missing DATA sheet, and various SerialNo formats.

tasks.title: Implement Excel row update logic
tasks.description: For existing SerialNos in DATA sheet, update columns H (Pm), I (Isc), J (Voc), K (Ipm), L (Vpm). Optionally update columns C (Date) and D (TTime). Preserve existing formatting. Never modify PALLET SHEET. Use openpyxl cell assignment.
tasks.details: Update existing rows in DATA sheet with new electrical values. Preserve all formatting and formulas. Ensure PALLET SHEET is never touched.
tasks.testStrategy: Test updating existing rows, verify formatting preserved, verify PALLET SHEET unchanged, and test with various data types.

tasks.title: Implement Excel row append logic
tasks.description: For new SerialNos not in DATA sheet, append new row at end. Populate columns B (SerialNo), C (Date), D (TTime), H (Pm), I (Isc), J (Voc), K (Ipm), L (Vpm). Preserve existing row formatting. Save workbook after updates.
tasks.details: Append new rows for SerialNos not found in DATA sheet. Match existing row formatting. Save workbook after all updates complete.
tasks.testStrategy: Test appending new rows, verify formatting matches existing rows, test with empty DATA sheet, and verify save functionality.

tasks.title: Implement processed file archiving
tasks.description: After successful processing, move input file from CSV_INPUT/ to ARCHIVE/processed_files/. Create archive directory if needed. Preserve original filename. Log archive location. Handle file move errors gracefully.
tasks.details: Move processed files to archive to prevent reprocessing. Create archive directory if missing. Log archive location for tracking.
tasks.testStrategy: Test file moving, directory creation, filename preservation, and error handling for permission issues.

tasks.title: Implement comprehensive logging
tasks.description: Log processed filename, selected workbook, updated/added/skipped counts, first 10 SerialNos processed, errors, warnings, and archive location. Format log entries with timestamps. Append to LOGS/import_log.txt.
tasks.details: Create detailed log entries for every import operation. Include all relevant information for troubleshooting and audit trail.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all information is logged correctly, timestamps are accurate, and log file is readable.

tasks.title: Implement console output
tasks.description: Display user-friendly summary: "Import complete. Updated: X, Added: Y, Skipped: Z. Open the pallet sheet, scan barcodes, and print." Print selected workbook name. Show any warnings or errors to user.
tasks.details: Provide clear, user-friendly console output that tells operators exactly what happened and what to do next.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify output format, counts are accurate, and messages are clear for operators.

tasks.title: Create Windows runner script
tasks.description: Create run_import.bat that changes to script directory, runs Python script, and pauses on completion. Make it user-friendly for double-click execution. Handle Python not found errors.
tasks.details: Create simple batch file for Windows operators to double-click and run import. Handle common errors gracefully.
tasks.testStrategy: Test double-click execution, verify directory change, test with Python not found, and verify pause on completion.

tasks.title: Create macOS runner script
tasks.description: Create run_import.command that changes to script directory, runs Python script, and keeps terminal open. Add execute permissions. Make it user-friendly for double-click execution. Handle Python not found errors.
tasks.details: Create shell script for macOS operators to double-click and run import. Ensure execute permissions are set.
tasks.testStrategy: Test double-click execution, verify execute permissions, test with Python not found, and verify terminal stays open.

tasks.title: Create main script integration
tasks.description: Combine all components into import_sunsim.py. Implement command-line argument parsing (--xlsx override). Add main() function with error handling. Ensure script never crashes on bad data. Add comprehensive error messages.
tasks.details: Integrate all components into main script. Add command-line interface. Ensure robust error handling throughout.
tasks.testStrategy: Test complete workflow, error handling, command-line arguments, and edge cases.

tasks.title: Create operator documentation
tasks.description: Write README.txt with clear instructions for operators. Include folder structure requirements, how to use runner scripts, troubleshooting steps, what to do if errors occur, and how to verify successful import.
tasks.details: Create comprehensive documentation for packout operators. Make it clear, simple, and focused on their workflow.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify documentation is clear, complete, and covers all operator scenarios.

tasks.title: Add progress indicators
tasks.description: Add progress indicators to show processing status during import. Display 'Processing X/Y (Z%)' messages every 10 records or at completion. Show progress for both file parsing and Excel update phases. Keep console output clean and user-friendly.
tasks.details: Implement progress feedback for operators, especially important for large files. Show progress during CSV/XLSX parsing and Excel updates.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with small and large files, verify progress messages appear correctly, ensure output is readable.

tasks.title: Implement dry-run mode
tasks.description: Implement dry-run mode with --dry-run flag. Process all data and show what would be updated/added, but don't actually save changes to Excel workbook. Display detailed summary of changes that would occur. This prevents accidental modifications and builds operator confidence.
tasks.details: Add --dry-run flag mentioned in PRD. Process everything but skip the save step. Show comprehensive summary of what would change.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dry-run mode shows correct preview, verify no changes are saved, test with various scenarios.

tasks.title: Add workbook structure validation
tasks.description: Add workbook structure validation function. Check that DATA sheet exists, verify required columns (B, H, I, J, K, L) are present, validate column structure matches expected format. Warn if structure looks wrong before processing. This prevents VLOOKUP formula breakage.
tasks.details: Critical safety feature to prevent VLOOKUP breakage. Validate workbook structure before making any changes.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with correct structure, missing columns, wrong sheet names, and malformed workbooks.

tasks.title: Enhance error messages
tasks.description: Enhance error messages to include row numbers, sample data, and actionable suggestions. When validation fails, show which row and what data caused the issue. Provide helpful hints like 'Check SerialNo format' or 'Verify electrical values are numeric'. Make errors more operator-friendly.
tasks.details: Improve error messages to be more helpful for operators. Include context and actionable advice.
tasks.testStrategy: Test error messages with various failure scenarios, verify row numbers are correct, check suggestions are helpful.

tasks.title: Add range validation for electrical values
tasks.description: Add range validation for electrical values. Define reasonable ranges (Pm: 0-1000W, Voc/Vpm: 0-100V, Isc/Ipm: 0-50A). Log warnings for out-of-range values but still process them. This catches data quality issues early without blocking valid edge cases.
tasks.details: Add data quality checks with configurable ranges. Warn but don't block processing.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with values in range, out of range, at boundaries. Verify warnings are logged correctly.

tasks.title: Implement verbose mode
tasks.description: Implement verbose mode with --verbose flag. Show detailed processing information including all SerialNos being processed (not just first 10), detailed field mappings, deduplication decisions, and step-by-step progress. Useful for debugging and troubleshooting.
tasks.details: Add --verbose flag mentioned in PRD. Provide detailed output for troubleshooting.
tasks.testStrategy: Test verbose mode shows all expected details, verify it doesn't clutter normal output.

tasks.title: Optimize performance with itertuples
tasks.description: Optimize performance by replacing iterrows() with itertuples() in CSV/XLSX parsing. This provides 3-5x speed improvement for large files. Also consider using read_only mode when reading Excel workbooks for SerialNo lookup.
tasks.details: Performance optimization: use itertuples() instead of iterrows(), use read_only mode for reading.
tasks.testStrategy: Test performance improvement with large files, verify functionality unchanged, benchmark speed.

tasks.title: Generate summary report CSV
tasks.description: Generate summary report CSV file after import. Include all SerialNos processed, before/after values for updates, added records, skipped records with reasons. Save to LOGS/ directory with timestamp. Provides better audit trail than just log file.
tasks.details: Create CSV report for better audit trail and record-keeping.
tasks.testStrategy: Test report generation, verify all data is included, check CSV format is correct.

tasks.title: Improve date/time parsing with python-dateutil
tasks.description: Improve date/time parsing using python-dateutil for more flexible date format handling. Add date validation to check for future dates and inconsistent formats. Enhance deduplication logic to better handle various date/time formats. This improves data integrity and handles more input file variations.
tasks.details: Use python-dateutil (mentioned in PRD) for better date parsing. Validate dates, check for future dates, improve deduplication.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various date formats, future dates, invalid dates, and verify deduplication works correctly.

tasks.title: Add SerialNo format validation
tasks.description: Add SerialNo format validation to detect suspicious patterns. Warn on SerialNos that are all zeros, all same character, or unusually short/long. Log format warnings for operator review. This catches data quality issues without blocking valid SerialNos.
tasks.details: Validate SerialNo patterns to catch data quality issues early.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with suspicious SerialNos (all zeros, repeated chars, very short/long) and verify warnings are logged.

tasks.title: Implement better error recovery
tasks.description: Implement better error recovery: continue processing even if some rows fail, provide summary of partial failures, and ensure transaction-like behavior where workbook is only saved if all critical operations succeed. This makes the tool more resilient to bad data while maintaining data integrity.
tasks.details: Make tool more resilient by continuing on partial failures while maintaining data integrity.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with files containing some bad rows, verify processing continues, check partial failure summary.

metadata.name: feature-2.0
metadata.description: Pallet Manager 2.0 implementation driven from PRD

tasks.title: Draft Pallet Manager 2.0 PRD document
tasks.description: Create a detailed Product Requirements Document for Pallet Manager 2.0 capturing goals, non-goals, users, scope, architecture, data model, APIs, UI/UX, migration strategy, and success metrics.
tasks.details: Author docs/PRD_PALLET_MANAGER_2_0.md based on 1.1 lessons learned and new 2.0 objectives. Ensure the document clearly describes intranet/offline-capable architecture, core entities, endpoint groups, and operational KPIs so that engineering and operations share the same expectations.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify PRD lives at docs/PRD_PALLET_MANAGER_2_0.md, is complete across all major sections, and is understandable to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

tasks.title: Define 2.0 technical direction and architecture
tasks.description: Lock in the 2.0 stack: Tauri + React desktop app, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL, MinIO object storage, background job strategy, and intranet deployment modes.
tasks.details: Confirm that the product will ship as a Tauri-wrapped React desktop client talking to a FastAPI service backed by PostgreSQL and MinIO, with support for dedicated intranet server, packout-hosted fallback, and offline-tolerant local deployment. Capture this direction in PRD Section 8 and supporting diagrams in the TDD.
tasks.testStrategy: Review PRD and TDD to ensure the chosen technologies, deployment modes, and data ownership model are explicitly documented and agreed.

tasks.title: Author Pallet Manager 2.0 Technical Design Document (TDD)
tasks.description: Create a TDD that translates the PRD into concrete module boundaries, APIs, data flows, and deployment details.
tasks.details: Author docs/TDD_PALLET_MANAGER_2_0.md to cover high-level component diagrams, service responsibilities, data model mapping from legacy JSON to PostgreSQL, API contracts, background processing model, and error-handling patterns. Ensure the design stays aligned with the PRD but is specific enough to guide implementation.
tasks.testStrategy: Review TDD for coverage of all PRD functional areas (auth, pallet lifecycle, search, simulator import, exports, audit) and verify there are no obvious gaps or contradictions.

tasks.title: Scaffold backend FastAPI project and database tooling
tasks.description: Create the backend service skeleton with FastAPI, configuration management, routing layout, Alembic migrations, and initial SQL schema file.
tasks.details: Set up backend/ with a FastAPI app, config loading, routing modules, and Alembic migration environment. Add backend/alembic/versions/20260303_0001_initial_schema.py and backend/schema_v1.sql as the first schema baseline. Ensure Dockerfile and tests are present so the service can be started in isolation.
tasks.testStrategy: Run backend unit tests and start the FastAPI app locally. Confirm Alembic can create and upgrade the schema from an empty database using the initial migration.

tasks.title: Scaffold React + Tauri frontend project
tasks.description: Initialize the Tauri + React/Vite desktop client with starter UI and project structure that matches PRD screens.
tasks.details: Create frontend/ with a Vite-based React app wired into Tauri, including basic routing, layout shell, and placeholder screens for Login, Dashboard, Pallet Builder, History Explorer, Import Center, Export Library, and Admin/Settings. Ensure dev scripts work on the target OS.
tasks.testStrategy: Run the Tauri dev build, confirm the app window opens and navigation between placeholder screens works without errors.

tasks.title: Create intranet Docker stack for API, DB, and MinIO
tasks.description: Provide a docker-compose configuration for the intranet deployment stack including API, PostgreSQL, MinIO, and optional worker.
tasks.details: Add docker-compose.intranet.yml with services for FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MinIO, and any background worker. Configure volumes for DB and object storage and expose ports suitable for intranet use. Resolve port conflicts (e.g., move Postgres host port to 5433) and ensure services can be brought up with a single command.
tasks.testStrategy: Run docker-compose using the intranet file and verify that API, Postgres, and MinIO are all reachable and healthy from the local machine.

tasks.title: Implement initial migration tooling and validate legacy import
tasks.description: Build Python scripts to migrate existing legacy JSON/CSV data into PostgreSQL and reconcile results against current 1.1 records.
tasks.details: Implement backend/scripts/migrate_legacy_data.py, backend/scripts/reconcile_migration.py, and backend/scripts/bootstrap_local_stack.sh to bootstrap the stack, run migrations, and compare counts and sample records. Use these tools to run a real migration and reconcile pallets, pallet_items, customers, and exports.
tasks.testStrategy: Run the migration end-to-end and verify that counts match expectations (e.g., pallets 4, pallet_items 15, customers 21, exports 4) and that reconciliation surfaces no critical discrepancies.

tasks.title: Establish 1.1 and 2.0 git branching model
tasks.description: Set up git branches main, release/1.1-fallback, and develop/2.0 and document the branching strategy for ongoing work.
tasks.details: Create and push the main, release/1.1-fallback, and develop/2.0 branches to GitHub, and add docs/BRANCHING_STRATEGY.md describing how 1.1 bugfixes and 2.0 features should flow through these branches.
tasks.testStrategy: Confirm all three branches exist on origin and that the branching strategy document accurately reflects the intended workflow.

tasks.title: Finalize and approve 2.0 PRD scope
tasks.description: Review the PRD with stakeholders, lock scope for 2.0, and track any out-of-scope items for future versions.
tasks.details: Walk through docs/PRD_PALLET_MANAGER_2_0.md with operations, purchasing, and IT to confirm goals, non-goals, and constraints. Capture sign-off, explicitly document open questions and decisions, and ensure scope aligns with realistic timeline and resources.
tasks.testStrategy: Hold a review session and record decisions; verify PRD is updated with final scope, open questions are clearly called out, and stakeholders acknowledge acceptance.

tasks.title: Finalize v1 data model and indexing strategy
tasks.description: Refine the PostgreSQL schema and indexes for users, roles, customers, pallets, pallet_items, sim_import_batches, sim_panels, exports, and audit_events based on PRD Section 9.
tasks.details: Iterate on backend/schema_v1.sql and Alembic migrations to ensure constraints, relationships, soft-delete behavior, and indexing (including partial/trigram indexes where useful) satisfy 2.0 search, reporting, and traceability requirements.
tasks.testStrategy: Run migrations against a fresh database and validate schema against PRD requirements. Use representative queries for search and history endpoints to confirm performance and correctness.
